source.author: verg
source.text: Stant pavidae in muris matres oculisque sequuntur pulveream nubem et fulgentis aere catervas.
source.text_original: Stant pavidae in muris matres oculisque sequuntur / pulveream nubem et fulgentis aere catervas.
source.text_english: The mothers stand fearfully on the walls and with their eyes follow the dusty cloud and the shining ranks in bronze.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: it pariter propulsa ratis; stant litore matres claraque vela oculis percussaque sole secuntur scuta virum, donec iam celsior arbore pontus immensusque ratem spectantibus abstulit aer.
reuse.text_original: it pariter propulsa ratis; stant litore matres / claraque vela oculis percussaque sole secuntur / scuta virum, donec iam celsior arbore pontus / immensusque ratem spectantibus abstulit aer.
reuse.text_english: The ship, driven on together, goes; mothers stand on the shore and, with their eyes, follow the bright sails and the shields of the men, struck by the sun, until the sea, now higher than the trees, and the vast air carried the ship away from the viewers.
